title: The model behind a virtual list
hints: Keep two vectors: the items as given, and `rows`, the indices of the visible items in display order. Sorting and filtering only rebuild `rows`.
Store the selection and the anchor as item ids, and translate to rows only when needed: then re-sorting cannot break them.
requirements: Column clicks sort and reverse with Explorer's natural order, and the order is fully deterministic.
The filter is case-insensitive and drops hidden items from the selection.
Click, Ctrl+click and Shift+click behave like Explorer's, and the selection survives re-sorting.
The status text matches the rules above exactly.
stretch: Add type-to-find (typing letters jumps to the next row whose name starts with them, like `LB_FINDSTRING`), and keyboard selection with Up, Down, Shift+Up and Shift+Down.
